messages:
mike_ops: Heads up — port congestion at FRA is pushing the H100 inbound ETA out ~5 days. Vendor flagged a potential holdback of 10% allocation if we don't accept split shipments. AWB: 123-FTW-9987
sara_procure: ugh. what's the proposed holdback? can we push for an alternative forwarder or air top-up? :weary:
tony_logistics: Vendor (GloboShip) says holdback = 10 units (of 100) until customs clears. They offered split: 90 by sea, 10 by air at +$4,500/unit. Need decision by EOD.
elena_fleet: If we accept split, we'll need to reserve depot slots for immediate staging. Depots in FRA are already ~80% full for the week of 6/10.
sara_procure: Can we negotiate to swap the cash upsell for a warranty extension or RMA credit instead?
mike_ops: asked vendor: "can we take a surcharge credit back as RMA coverage for DOA within 90 days?" waiting on response.
GloboShip-bot: Vendor reply — surcharge credit instead of fee is case-by-case. They can provide a EUR 2000 credit per delayed batch if we sign an LOI waiver. ETA for final confirmation: 24h.
jin-enginfra: Also FYI, cluster autoscaler can hold ~8 H100s locally for critical failover but we need serial-matching for inventory tagging. Partial shipments will complicate serial reconciliation.
tony_logistics: On RMA flow: depot asked for consolidated return AWB and photo evidence. If we split now, we must create two RMA batches — extra handling fee ~€150 per RMA.
elena_fleet: Can we front-load acceptance at AMS instead? AMS transit is +2 days vs FRA +5, but extra rail cost ~€1k/unit.
sara_procure: quick math — air top-up $4.5k/unit vs rail + staging ~€1k + customs brokerage ~€300. Looks cheaper to do rail and accept a small delay.
mike_ops: decision proposal: 1) Accept split (90 sea / 10 rail) 2) Negotiate EUR2000 credit per delayed sea batch or depot fee waiver 3) Update RMA docs to accept split AWBs and tag serial ranges for partial arrivals.
sara_procure: +1 to that. i'll push vendor for credit + waive LOI.
GloboShip-bot: Vendor note: can confirm rail lanes available for 10 units, provisional hold until 18:00 UTC. Need PO amendment to lock.
mike_ops: filing PO amendment draft:
```
PO-4321 amendment: allow split shipment FRA/AMS, accept two AWBs, vendor credit = EUR2000 per delayed sea batch, rail surcharge capped at EUR1000/unit.
```
elena_fleet: pinging depot ops to reserve 20% staging capacity and hold ramp slots. cc @depot-ops
deopot-ops: noted. reserving 12 slots provisional. need final AWB by 18:30.
jin-enginfra: reminder: update inventory import script to accept `serial_range` field in CSV and map to node-tag when partial shipments arrive. Quick patch in repo: `tools/inv/serial-import`.
mike_ops: ok — i'll route PO amendment + RMA flow doc to legal. thanks team :thumbsup:
